meta.name: cost-accounting
meta.description: Establishes what something actually costs — fixed, variable and mixed cost behavior, absorption versus variable costing, job-order, process and activity-based methods, breakeven and operating leverage, and price/volume/mix decomposition. Use this to set a price floor, explain why revenue or margin moved, decide make versus buy, judge whether a product line earns its place, or work out how an allocation basis is distorting a reported margin.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 核算真实成本,拆解利润变动,定出价格底线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你要算清产品成本、为定价或盈亏分析发愁。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate true product costs and set data-driven price floors.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to understand cost structure and make informed pricing or make-or-buy decisions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按成本会计方法分析：先判别成本是固定、变动还是混合，再按业务情况选分批/分步/作业成本法，计算保本点，把收入变化拆成价格、数量、组合，并指出按收入分摊间接费可能误导利润。
howto.when: 当问题涉及成本、定价或利润分析时，或要判断自制/外购、产品线取舍等决策时，会按成本会计方法分析。

say.text: 这款产品定价多少才不亏本？
say.note: 会结合变动成本和固定成本算保本价。

say.text: 帮我把营收变化拆成价格、数量和组合的影响。
say.note: 会分别算三部分各自贡献多少。

say.text: 这个零件是自制还是外购合算？
say.note: 会比较相关成本后给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude will analyze costs with cost-accounting methods: separate fixed/variable/mixed costs, choose job-order, process, or activity-based costing, compute break-even, decompose revenue changes into price/volume/mix, and flag misleading overhead allocated by revenue.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the question concerns costs, pricing, or profit analysis, or when asking for a make-or-buy or product-line decision.

say_en.text: What minimum price would make this product break even?
say_en.note: It will use variable and fixed costs to find the price floor.

say_en.text: Decompose the revenue change into price, volume, and mix effects.
say_en.note: It reports how much each factor contributed.

say_en.text: Should we make this component or outsource it?
say_en.note: It compares relevant costs and gives a recommendation.
